title: Make TTS restart recovery explicit
description: Recover interrupted persistent TTS work as a safe failed state, preserve per-segment retryability, and prevent Electron startup from automatically invoking provider-backed TTS jobs.
businessContext: V1 requires restart recovery to preserve production progress without silently resuming paid or provider-backed work. The existing startup path converts running TTS jobs to queued and immediately runs every queued job.
dependencies: existing per-segment TTS retry IPC and Voice screen action
acceptanceCriteria: A running TTS job recovered after restart is marked failed with a safe interruption error, and its running segments are marked failed without deleting successful or queued segment progress.
Electron startup does not automatically call a provider-backed TTS job for recovered or queued work.
The existing explicit failed-segment retry path remains usable after recovery and does not regenerate successful segments.
Focused TTS persistence/service checks, typecheck, and diff checks pass.
verificationCommands: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/db/test/persistence.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/ttsJobService.test.ts
humanEscalationConditions: Explicit retry cannot safely resume only the interrupted segment without changing the existing IPC contract.
Recovery requires a database migration or a new provider/idempotency mechanism.
